subject: DI05000171

title.en: Power Semiconductor Devices and Driver Circuits
title.gu: પાવર સેમિકન્ડક્ટર ડિવાઇસ તથા ડ્રાઇવર સર્કિટ

title.en: 1.1 Power converters and practical switching

body.en:
Definition

A power electronic converter changes the electrical form or controlled magnitude of power using semiconductor switching and energy-storage/filter components.

Classification / scope

  • Conversion: rectifier/chopper/inverter/AC controller; control: uncontrolled/semi/fully controlled; isolation: nonisolated/isolated.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • AC–DC rectifier, DC–DC chopper, DC–AC inverter and AC–AC controller classify conversion; device choice and control method are separate axes.
  • An ideal ON switch has zero drop; an ideal OFF switch blocks voltage with zero leakage; transitions are instantaneous. Practical devices have conduction/switching losses, leakage, parasitics and finite safe operating area.
  • A transistor with an antiparallel diode may carry reverse current but does not automatically block both voltage polarities. An SCR cannot normally be turned off by removing its gate pulse.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Power electronic converter semiconductor switching તથા energy-storage/filterથી powerનું electrical form અથવા controlled magnitude બદલે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Conversion: rectifier/chopper/inverter/AC controller; control: uncontrolled/semi/fully; isolation: nonisolated/isolated.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • AC–DC rectifier, DC–DC chopper, DC–AC inverter/AC–AC controller conversionના classes છે; device/control અલગ axes છે.
  • Ideal ONમાં zero drop/OFFમાં zero leakage અને instant transitions; practicalમાં losses, leakage, parasitics/limited SOA છે.
  • Antiparallel diodeથી reverse current મળે પણ bipolar voltage blocking automatic નહીં.SCR gate pulse દૂર કરવાથી સામાન્ય turn-off નહીં.

title.en: 1.2 Power MOSFET: structure, working and characteristics
title.gu: 1.2 Power MOSFET: Structure, Working તથા Characteristics

h.en: Power MOSFET: structure, working and characteristics
h.gu: Power MOSFET: Structure, Working તથા Characteristics

h.en: SCR: PNPN structure, latching and static characteristic
h.gu: SCR: PNPN Structure, Latching તથા Static Characteristic

body.en:
Definition

A silicon-controlled rectifier is a three-terminal PNPN thyristor that can latch into forward conduction after a suitable trigger and normally turns off only when current and recovery conditions permit.

Construction / circuit connections

  1. PNPN layers form three junctions with anode, cathode and gate near the cathode-side control region.
  2. The two-transistor equivalent explains regenerative feedback; gate starts regeneration but ordinary gate removal does not interrupt main current.

Working / conduction intervals

  1. Forward bias blocks until permitted gate triggering establishes conduction and anode current exceeds latching requirement.
  2. Current must fall below holding level and sufficient turn-off time tq must be provided before forward blocking is relied on.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Forward blocking, forward conduction and reverse blocking form the principal static regions; breakover firing is not a preferred normal trigger method.
  • Latching current IL is the anode current needed just after triggering to remain ON when gate support ends; holding current IH is the minimum established conduction current below which turn-off can begin. Usually IL>IH.
  • Gate drive must meet amplitude, width, polarity and power limits at the actual load/firing point; reverse gate stress and dv/dt false triggering are not ignored.

Additional labelled circuit / characteristic
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

SCR three-terminal PNPN thyristor છે જે suitable triggerથી forward conductionમાં latch થાય અને current/recovery conditionsથી સામાન્ય OFF થાય છે.

Construction / સર્કિટનાં જોડાણ

  1. PNPNમાં ત્રણ junctions/anode, cathode/cathode-side gate છે.
  2. Two-transistor equivalent regenerative feedback સમજાવે; gate શરૂ કરે, removal main current તોડતું નથી.

Working / Conductionનો ક્રમ

  1. Forward biasમાં gate trigger/latching current સુધી blocking રહે.
  2. Current IHની નીચે અને sufficient tq પછી જ forward blocking પર ભરોસો રાખો.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Forward blocking, conduction/reverse blocking મુખ્ય regions છે; breakover normal preferred trigger નહીં.
  • IL trigger પછી gate support દૂર થાય ત્યારે latch રહેવા જરૂરી current; IH established conduction જાળવવાનો minimum; સામાન્ય IL>IH.
  • Gate amplitude, width, polarity/power actual load/firing મુજબ; reverse gate/dv/dt false trigger અવગણશો નહીં.

વધારાની Labelled Circuit / Characteristic

title.en: 1.3 WBG materials: SiC and GaN without blanket claims

h.en: WBG materials: SiC and GaN without blanket claims

body.en:
Definition

A wide-band-gap semiconductor has a larger forbidden energy gap than silicon, enabling device designs with different electric-field, temperature and switching capabilities.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • SiC MOSFETs/diodes and GaN power transistors are technology examples, not synonyms for one device structure. Fast edges can reduce switching loss but increase EMI and layout sensitivity.
  • Actual voltage/current, gate range, reverse conduction, reliability and thermal packaging must come from the specific datasheet. Not every GaN device has a silicon-MOSFET body diode.
  • A silicon gate driver cannot be assumed safe for every SiC/GaN part; gate overshoot and common-mode transient immunity become particularly important.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

WBG semiconductorમાં silicon કરતાં larger forbidden energy gap હોય છે જેથી electric-field, temperature/switching capabilitiesવાળી designs મળે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • SiC MOSFET/diode તથા GaN transistor examples છે, એક structure નહીં.Fast edges losses ઘટાડે પણ EMI/layout sensitivity વધારે.
  • Actual ratings, gate range, reverse conduction/reliability/package datasheetથી; દરેક GaNમાં silicon-MOSFET body diode નથી.
  • Silicon driver દરેક SiC/GaN માટે safe નમાનો; gate overshoot/CMTI ખાસ મહત્વનાં.

title.en: 1.4 Protection against overvoltage, short circuit, dv/dt and di/dt
title.gu: 1.4 Overvoltage, Short Circuit, dv/dt તથા di/dt Protection

h.en: Protection against overvoltage, short circuit, dv/dt and di/dt
h.gu: Overvoltage, Short Circuit, dv/dt તથા di/dt Protection

body.en:
Definition

Device protection keeps voltage, current, temperature and switching trajectories within the permitted limits during normal operation and credible faults.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Overvoltage: control stray inductance, commutation loops and use coordinated clamps/snubber/arrester where appropriate; an arbitrary large capacitor may worsen turn-on current.
  • Short circuit: fast sensing, cycle-by-cycle current limit or DESAT as applicable, controlled turn-off and rated fuse/breaker coordination; not all MOSFET/IGBT parts have a specified short-circuit withstand time.
  • High dv/dt couples displacement current through parasitic capacitances and can false-trigger devices; high di/dt causes local SCR current crowding and inductive overshoot.
  • Gate resistance, Miller clamp, proper return path, dead time and layout complement protection; fuse I²t must be checked against device data and circuit fault energy.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Device protection normal/faultમાં voltage, current, temperature/switching trajectoryને permitted limitsમાં રાખે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Overvoltage માટે stray L/loops તથા coordinated clamp/snubber; arbitrary મોટો capacitor turn-on current વધારી શકે.
  • Short circuitમાં sensing/current limit/DESAT/controlled off/fuse coordination; દરેક deviceને specified withstand time નથી.
  • High dv/dt parasitic capacitanceથી false triggering; high di/dt SCR current crowding/inductive overshoot આપે.
  • Gate resistor, Miller clamp, return path, dead time/layout મદદ કરે; fuse I²t device/circuit energy સાથે check કરો.

body.en:
Definition

An RC snubber is a deliberately damped resistor-capacitor network used to shape a switching transient and limit an identified stress; its values depend on the circuit and parasitic energy.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • An RC across a switch can limit dv/dt while the resistor damps oscillation and limits capacitor-discharge current; it is not a substitute for all overvoltage/short-circuit protection.
  • Use pulse-rated capacitor/resistor with appropriate voltage, energy, temperature and layout; measure overshoot with an appropriate probe, not a long ground lead.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. If an approximately constant transient current It charges C, It=C dv/dt; therefore C≥It/(dv/dt)target.
  2. For It=0.2A and100V/µs, C≥2nF. This is an initial slope estimate, not final circuit approval.
  3. If parasitic Lp and C dominate ringing, a first damping scale is R≈√(Lp/C).With Lp=2µH, C=2nF, R≈31.6Ω; verify actual waveform/device limits.
  4. Capacitor energy per charge is½CV².At400V and2nF it is0.16mJ; 20kHz gives3.2W for one such dissipated energy event per cycle. Actual topology may dissipate more.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

RC snubber identified switching stress/transientને shape કરવા damped R–C network છે; values circuit/parasitic energy પર આધારિત છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Switch across RC dv/dt limit કરે અને R oscillation/discharge current control કરે; બધી protectionનો વિકલ્પ નહીં.
  • Pulse-rated C/Rમાં voltage, energy, T/layout જુઓ; proper probeથી overshoot માપો, long ground lead નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Constant transient It માટે It=C dv/dtથી C≥It/(dv/dt)target.
  2. It=0.2A/100V/µsમાં C≥2nF; initial estimate છે, final approval નહીં.
  3. Lp/C ringingમાં first scale R≈√(Lp/C); 2µH/2nFમાં≈31.6Ω; actual waveform/limits verify કરો.
  4. ½CV²થી400V/2nFમાં0.16mJ; 20kHzમાં one-event/cycle3.2W; actual topologyમાં વધુ હોઈ શકે.

h.en: Losses, cooling and heatsink thermal path
h.gu: Losses, Cooling તથા Heatsink Thermal Path

body.en:
Definition

A heatsink conducts and rejects device heat so that the junction temperature remains below its allowed operating limit with appropriate design margin.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • MOSFET conduction loss approximately Irms²RDS(on); IGBT/SCR conduction uses the current-weighted on-state voltage. Switching loss may use(Eon+Eoff)fs at matching test conditions.
  • Transient thermal impedance, pulse duration, airflow, interface insulation and mounting pressure matter; case-connected tabs may be electrically live.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Steady Tj≈Ta+Ploss(Rθjc+Rθcs+Rθsa).Assume a single device and a valid steady thermal network.
  2. Thus Rθsa≤(Tj, target−Ta)/Ploss−Rθjc−Rθcs.
  3. At Ploss=20W, Ta=40°C, Tj, target=125°C, Rθjc=1°C/W, Rθcs=0.5°C/W, required Rθsa≤2.75°C/W before further margins/shared-heatsink effects.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Heatsink device heat conduct/reject કરીને junction temperatureને allowed limit કરતાં margin સાથે નીચે રાખે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • MOSFET loss Irms²RDS(on); IGBT/SCRમાં current-weighted drop; switching loss matching conditionsમાં(Eon+Eoff)fs.
  • Transient thermal impedance, pulses, airflow, interface/mounting મહત્વનાં; case tab live હોઈ શકે.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Single device/steady networkમાં Tj≈Ta+Ploss(Rθjc+Rθcs+Rθsa).
  2. તેથી Rθsa≤(Tj, target−Ta)/Ploss−Rθjc−Rθcs.
  3. 20W, 40°C, 125°C, 1°C/W/0.5°C/Wમાં Rθsa≤2.75°C/W; further margin/shared sink હજી જુઓ.

title.en: 1.5 SCR natural and forced commutation

body.en:
Definition

Commutation of an SCR is the process of extinguishing its current and providing sufficient recovery conditions so it regains forward-blocking capability.

Classification / scope

  • Natural(line) and forced(auxiliary energy/current reversal) are the main classes.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Natural/line commutation uses an AC circuit current zero with adequate recovery time; voltage zero and current zero need not coincide for an inductive load.
  • Forced commutation uses an auxiliary circuit to drive current below holding and/or apply reverse bias when the DC source offers no natural zero.
  • Load, resonant-pulse, auxiliary/complementary and external-pulse methods describe common teaching arrangements; the actual available circuit turn-off time must exceed device tq with margin.
  • Removing an ordinary SCR gate pulse is not forced commutation; GTO/IGCT are different device families.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

SCR commutation current extinguish કરીને sufficient recoveryથી forward-blocking capability પાછી લાવવાની પ્રક્રિયા છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Natural(line)/forced(auxiliary energy/current reversal) મુખ્ય classes છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Natural/line commutation AC current zero/recovery વાપરે; inductiveમાં voltage-current zero સમાન નહીં.
  • Forcedમાં DCના natural zero વિના auxiliary circuit current IHની નીચે/reverse bias આપે.
  • Load, resonant, auxiliary/complementary/external-pulse common arrangements છે; available turn-off time tq કરતાં marginથી વધુ જોઈએ.
  • Ordinary SCR gate removal forced commutation નથી; GTO/IGCT જુદા families છે.

title.en: 1.6 Gate/base drive: charge, current and isolation requirements
title.gu: 1.6 Gate/Base Drive: Charge, Current તથા Isolation

h.en: Gate/base drive: charge, current and isolation requirements
h.gu: Gate/Base Drive: Charge, Current તથા Isolation

body.en:
Definition

A gate or base driver translates a control command into the correctly referenced voltage/current waveform needed to switch a power device safely and predictably.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • MOSFET/IGBT gates are capacitive charge-controlled during transitions; BJT base drive needs sustained current while ON and charge removal at turn-off. SCR triggering needs a gate pulse but main current commutation remains separate.
  • Check source/sink current, UVLO, propagation delay, dead time, CMTI, isolation working rating, creepage and local decoupling. High-side drive needs a supply referenced to its moving source/emitter.
  • A bootstrap supply may need refresh intervals and cannot be assumed to sustain100%duty indefinitely; isolation test voltage is not the continuous working-voltage rating.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Approximate gate-drive average power Pg≈QgVdrivefs; transition pulse current I≈Qg/tcharge is only a first estimate.
  2. For Qg=40nC, Vdrive=12V, fs=20kHz, Pg≈9.6mW; charging that amount in100ns needs about0.4A, showing average power alone does not size the driver.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Gate/base driver control commandને power device safe switch કરવા યોગ્ય referenced voltage/current waveformમાં ફેરવે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • MOSFET/IGBTમાં transition charge; BJTમાં sustained base current/off charge removal; SCR gate pulse/main commutation જુદાં.
  • Source/sink, UVLO, delay, dead time, CMTI, isolation/creepage/decoupling જુઓ; high-side supply moving source/emitter referenceમાં.
  • Bootstrap refresh જોઈએ/100%duty અનંત નમાનો; isolation test voltage continuous working rating નથી.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Pg≈QgVdrivefs; I≈Qg/tcharge initial estimate છે.
  2. 40nC/12V/20kHzમાં Pg≈9.6mW; 100nsમાં≈0.4A, એટલે average powerથી driver select નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

An isolated driver transfers a control signal across a rated insulation barrier while maintaining the device-side gate drive relative to its own source/emitter/cathode.

Construction / circuit connections

  1. Control side generates bounded pulses; barrier provides rated insulation; device side has return path, bias, decoupling and gate protection.

Working / conduction intervals

  1. A transformer pulse must be reset before the next cycle; an optical signal commands a powered output stage with its specified delays.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Pulse transformer drive transfers changing flux/pulses, not a steady DC level. It needs volt-second reset, magnetising-current control and pulse-width/duty considerations.
  • Optocoupler isolation transfers light; its output normally needs a local isolated supply and adequate gate-drive stage. Delay, CTR for signal optocouplers, ageing and CMTI must be checked.
  • A bare optocoupler transistor is not automatically a high-current isolated gate driver. Example: logic→rated optodriver→gate resistor→MOSFET gate, with gate-source discharge resistor and local decoupling.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Isolated driver rated barrierથી signal મોકલે અને device-side gateને તેના source/emitter/cathode referenceમાં drive કરે છે.

Construction / સર્કિટનાં જોડાણ

  1. Control side bounded pulses/barrier insulation/device side return, bias, decoupling/gate protection.

Working / Conductionનો ક્રમ

  1. Transformer pulse next પહેલાં reset; optical signal powered output stageને specified delays સાથે command આપે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Pulse transformer changing pulses transfer કરે, steady DC નહીં; volt-second reset, magnetising current/pulse-duty limits જોઈએ.
  • Optocoupler light transfer કરે; outputને local isolated supply/adequate drive જોઈએ.Delay, signal CTR, ageing/CMTI જુઓ.
  • Bare optocoupler automatic high-current driver નથી.Example logic→rated optodriver→Rg→gate; gate-source discharge/decoupling સાથે.

title.en: 1.7 Freewheel diode: current continuity and load voltage
title.gu: 1.7 Freewheel Diode: Current Continuity તથા Load Voltage

h.en: Freewheel diode: current continuity and load voltage
h.gu: Freewheel Diode: Current Continuity તથા Load Voltage

body.en:
Definition

A freewheel diode provides a local path for inductive load current when the main source-switch path is removed or becomes reverse biased.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Inductor current cannot jump instantly; without a suitable path, parasitics force a high voltage. Freewheeling clamps load voltage near a diode drop but does not force load current to zero instantly.
  • Connect the diode antiparallel to the positive-current load: anode at negative load terminal, cathode at positive terminal. Select current, reverse voltage, recovery and thermal ratings.
  • An antiparallel bridge diode may return energy to the DC link; freewheeling and regeneration are related current paths but not always the same energy destination.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Freewheel diode source-switch path દૂર/reverse થાય ત્યારે inductive load current માટે local path આપે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Inductor current instant બદલાતો નથી; path વિના high voltage થાય.Freewheel load V clamp કરે, current instant zero નહીં.
  • Positive-current load across diode: anode negative/cathode positive; current, reverse V, recovery/thermal select કરો.
  • Bridge diode energy DC linkમાં પરત આપી શકે; freewheel/regenerationની energy destination હંમેશાં સમાન નહીં.

title.en: 1.8 Datasheet interpretation and harmonics

body.en:
Definition

A device rating is a permitted limit under explicitly stated electrical, thermal and timing conditions; harmonics are sinusoidal components at integer multiples of a fundamental frequency.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Read VDS/VCE/VRRM, current test temperature, pulse width, SOA, gate limits, RDS(on)/VCE(sat), Qg, switching energies, diode recovery and transient thermal impedance together. Maximum ratings are not recommended simultaneous operating points.
  • Use current and voltage margins based on actual overshoot/ripple and junction temperature; do not choose a device merely because the printed current exceeds average load current.
  • Harmonics increase RMS heating, transformer/cable loss, torque ripple, noise and possible resonance. EMI at switching frequencies and low-order line harmonics require different filter/control considerations.
  • True PF=P/(VrmsIrms); with sinusoidal voltage and distorted current, it is displacement PF multiplied by current distortion factor I1, rms/Irms. Improving displacement alone need not remove harmonic current.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Device rating stated electrical, thermal/timing conditionsનું limit છે; harmonics fundamentalના integer multiplesનાં components છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Voltage, current test T/pulse, SOA, gate, drop, Qg, energy, recovery/thermal સાથે વાંચો; maximum ratings simultaneous recommended points નથી.
  • Actual overshoot/ripple/Tjથી margins લો; printed current average કરતાં વધુ છે એટલું પૂરતું નહીં.
  • Harmonics RMS heat, loss, torque ripple, noise/resonance વધારેછે; switching EMI/low-order line harmonicsના filters જુદા હોય.
  • True PF=P/(VrmsIrms); sinusoidal V/distorted Iમાં displacement PF×I1, rms/Irms; displacement સુધરે એટલે harmonics દૂર નહીં.

title.en: J1 Project 1. Isolated optocoupler MOSFET driver

body.en:
Definition

A source-suggested learning plan, not a claim that fabrication, testing or a visit has occurred.

Working / conduction intervals

  1. Write objective, ratings, assumptions, roles, resources and approved safe work boundary before starting.
  2. Select a rated optodriver/local isolated supply, gate resistor, discharge resistor, decoupling and a low-energy MOSFET test load.
  3. Check expected results independently and obtain instructor approval before any permitted low-energy demonstration.
  4. Submit circuit, gate-charge/current estimate, delay/CMTIrequirements and genuine isolated waveform evidence; bare optocoupler output is not automatically adequate.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Select a rated optodriver/local isolated supply, gate resistor, discharge resistor, decoupling and a low-energy MOSFET test load.
  • Submit circuit, gate-charge/current estimate, delay/CMTIrequirements and genuine isolated waveform evidence; bare optocoupler output is not automatically adequate.

Reliability and precautions

  • Keep actual date, measurements, teacher sign and portfolio evidence blank until genuine; no exposed mains, battery abuse or unqualified high-energy switching.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Source-suggested learning plan છે, fabrication/test/visit થઈ ગયાનો claim નહીં.

Working / Conductionનો ક્રમ

  1. પહેલાં objective, ratings, assumptions, roles, resources/safeboundaryલખો.
  2. Rated optodriver/local isolated supply, Rg, dischargeR, decoupling/low-energyMOSFET load પસંદ કરો.
  3. Expectedresultsindependentlycheck/lowenergydemoપહેલાં approval.
  4. Circuit, Qg/current, delay/CMTI/actual waveform આપો; bare optocoupler adequate assume નહીં.

title.en: Official practical guides

body.en:
Definition

A source-listed performance guide; actual execution, date, readings and signatures are not claimed.

Construction / circuit connections

  1. Isolated low-energy driver supply, logic pulse source, selected transistor, dummy gate load/Rg, DSO with appropriate probe.
  2. Logic→driver→gate resistor→gate; local source/emitter return, decoupling, pull-down and current-limited load; choose one source-listed isolation/drive method.

Working / conduction intervals

  1. Review actual circuit/device data, instrument/probe ratings, safe stop/isolation and stored-energy discharge before work.
  2. Power OFF: verify polarity, earth/return, gate mapping, load rating and current limit; never defeat a protection/interlock.
  3. Verify datasheet gate limits/UVLO and both power-off states; start with a dummy gate load before a switching device.
  4. Measure gate-source/emitter voltage, rise/fall delay and ringing at the device pins; increase frequency only within the approved low-energy plan.
  5. Record only genuinely measured/simulated results with units, conditions and evidence; leave actual columns blank until performed.
  6. Return to safe state, isolate, verify stored energy discharged and compare result with assumptions/losses rather than fabricating expected readings.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Source number1, internal identifier1; CO1.Individual suggested hours/compulsory stars are not provided.
  • Student construction is isolated, current-limited≤24Vonly with every generated output/stored energy assessed; higher-energy tests use approved guarded trainers and qualified supervision.

Worked example

  1. Qg40nC, 12V, 20kHzgives9.6mWaverage gate power but about0.4Afor100nscharge; computed, not measured.

Reliability and precautions

  • No gate waveform: check logic polarity, isolated output bias, UVLO and return before changing transistor. High-side probes must tolerate common-mode voltage.
  • Never lift oscilloscope protective earth or attach an earth-referenced ground clip across a floating bridge. Use correctly rated differential/isolated measurement; an isolation transformer is not blanket probe safety.

  4. Safe bounded V/I/selected gates; ON/OFF/Tનોંધો, avalanche/overheat નહીં.
  5. SCR latch/holding approved current ઘટાડીને; transistors output/transfer family plot.
  6. ખરેખર માપેલા કે simulate કરેલા results જ units, conditions તથા evidence સાથે લખો.પ્રયોગ પહેલાં actual readingsનાં ખાના ખાલી રાખો.
  7. Setupને safe stateમાં લાવો, isolate કરો અને discharge verify કરો.Assumptions તથા lossesથી તફાવત સમજાવો; expected readingsને actual તરીકે નલખો.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Source number3, internalID3; CO1; individual hours/compulsory stars આપેલ નથી.
  • વિદ્યાર્થીનું construction માત્ર isolated, current-limited≤24Vમાં કરવું; generated output અને stored energyનું પણ assessment કરવું.Higher-energy test approved guarded trainer પર qualified supervisionથી જ કરવો.

ઉકેલેલું ઉદાહરણ

  1. Fully-enhanced resistive regionમાં જ RDS(on)=VDS/ID; threshold full-drive નથી.

વિશ્વસનીયતા તથા સાવચેતી

  • Unexpected curvesમાં terminals, loading, current-limit/heat; continuous sweep SOA exceed કરી શકે.
  • Oscilloscopeનું protective earth ક્યારેય દૂર નકરો.Floating bridge પર earth-referenced ground clip નજોડો; યોગ્ય rated differential/isolated measurement વાપરો.Isolation transformerથી દરેક probing method safe થઈ જતી નથી.
